dfe3b6f6799715445a520594263afa6e6eccf6b7.pinyin: ān zhuāng jìng shuǐ qì zhī qián, shī fu xiān jiǎn chá le shuǐ guǎn.
dfe3b6f6799715445a520594263afa6e6eccf6b7.text: 安装净水器之前，师傅先检查了水管。

dfe4d4fcdd80821fc566e9a6d4ab9550c033c8a7.pinyin: tā zhōng yú nòng qīng chǔ zěn me gǎo dìng zhè shì le.
dfe4d4fcdd80821fc566e9a6d4ab9550c033c8a7.text: 他终于弄清楚怎幺搞定这事了。

dfe50d27448bff88450e584e5afaf169287bdb45.pinyin: Zhè gēn fāng cái de liǎng duān dōu qiē de hěn píng zhěng.
dfe50d27448bff88450e584e5afaf169287bdb45.text: 这根枋材的两端都切得很平整。

dfe61ebabb66f18e3b8875dcd079dd01d3e7a8a5.pinyin: tā yuàn yì chū tíng zuò zhèng.

dfe7754b2ac4c06cb49476b5b9ac669ccc8abbda.pinyin: zhè zhī māo zǒng shì dú lái dú wǎng, bù gēn qí tā māo yī qǐ wán.
dfe7754b2ac4c06cb49476b5b9ac669ccc8abbda.text: 这只猫总是独来独往，不跟其他猫一起玩。

dfe98719b49fd17bb2786d926555e862dc466513.pinyin: nǐ men bù néng jiě gù wǒ men.

dfe9936727e52d351ef465230b4fad0d276d6a72.pinyin: bào zi xiāo xià le báo báo de mù xiè.
dfe9936727e52d351ef465230b4fad0d276d6a72.text: 刨子削下了薄薄的木屑。

dfe9d0cc6394054c54206be41b6e41df575caa05.pinyin: qiú duì yǐ méi yǒu tuì lù, zhǐ néng zài jué sài zhōng bèi shuǐ yī zhàn.
dfe9d0cc6394054c54206be41b6e41df575caa05.text: 球队已没有退路，只能在决赛中背水一战。

dfec6376f284f33681bfd0634d82507578b32b79.pinyin: tā de fā yán zá luàn wú zhāng, ràng tīng zhòng zhuā bù zhù zhòng diǎn.
dfec6376f284f33681bfd0634d82507578b32b79.text: 他的发言杂乱无章，让听众抓不住重点。

dff27840ae5765585b600849f1f7ef547a0b57ce.pinyin: hé liú bù duàn gǎi biàn dì mào.

dff330a7c2ed3ebcf478afe4ec5ab08094cf422b.pinyin: tāng mǔ zhèng kǎo lǜ yìng pìn xīn chóu gèng gāo de gōng zuò.
dff330a7c2ed3ebcf478afe4ec5ab08094cf422b.text: 汤姆正考虑应聘薪酬更高的工作。

dff67181e65f5d74b9a3a239d887e765df0c84d9.pinyin: lí zhè lǐ zuì jìn de shī wù zhāo lǐng chǔ zài nǎ lǐ?
dff67181e65f5d74b9a3a239d887e765df0c84d9.text: 离这里最近的失物招领处在哪里？

dff73ed47a6d4c2df077faa68dc0787b254d88ea.pinyin: hái zi men yǒu wàng shèng de qiú zhī yù.
dff73ed47a6d4c2df077faa68dc0787b254d88ea.text: 孩子们有旺盛的求知欲。

dff76878c407fa391bf994d8725f1f5647953926.pinyin: wǒ men de zhuā fàn shì sì kuài qián.

dff9a8cb4f27bd49d935da9edc4dd58dab62790f.pinyin: xiǎng dào zì jǐ de shī lǐ, tā gǎn dào cán zuò.
dff9a8cb4f27bd49d935da9edc4dd58dab62790f.text: 想到自己的失礼，他感到惭怍。
